items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: And Pha was a beautiful singer and that's what really made them. Everything they did with Pha singing was a hit.

ctx.x: Despite the Pha Terrell vocal or-----

Yeah, it was more of a sweet, smooth band. Actually, it wasn't a band like the Bennie Moten band or the Basie band, but very, very clean and recorded very well because they were light and they recorded perfectly. I mean, they were beautiful for recording. And Pha was a beautiful singer and that's what really made them. Everything they did with Pha singing was a hit.
Wasn't Andy at one time associated with the same school as Whiteman in Denver?
